simple.meaning: חַטָּאָה (chaṭṭâʼâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an offence , and the penalty or sacrifice for it.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezra, beginning at Ezra 6:17. Its contexts include offering, Israel.
